finding_map.v2_locus: source 771-777, 780-793 (RD05E sleep_crossing hook and case check); plan RD05E
finding_map.finding: Hook entered after the 1s control deadline already expired sets the crossing witness without any witnessed transition; MATCH could falsely attribute a post-native-return crossing.
finding_map.planned_change: Hook first measures the unchanged control deadline at entry; if already expired it latches real_entry_expired and returns without a witness; the witness (renamed real_crossing_witnessed) is set only after looping from an unexpired entry to an expired exit. The case raises InconclusivePrecondition when entry was expired or no transition was witnessed. Plan v4 RD05E procedure states the entry-unexpired requirement; expected object unchanged.

finding_map.finding: _emit or report failure replaces the propagating BaseException; bootstrap emission failure bypasses owned.close_since(0); report retention unprotected against a secondary BaseException.
finding_map.planned_change: New _secondary(function, latch): best-effort work while a primary BaseException propagates, every secondary failure (any BaseException) latched by type and never raised. Bootstrap handler: report and emission via _secondary inside try, owned.close_since(0, primary=exc) in finally, then bare raise of the original. Per-case handler moved into _base_exception_line(...) with the same structure (report, retention, compact emission best effort; cleanup unconditional under the primary), then bare raise. Emergency lines record secondary_failure_types.

finding_map.finding: Fixture-close finalizers call a raising close; an ordinary close error replaces an earlier propagating BaseException.
finding_map.planned_change: _Owned.close(row, primary=None) keeps exactly one attempt and latches every error; with an active primary it never replaces it (returns the error) except that a newly arising non-Exception BaseException escalates over an ordinary-Exception primary. _Fx.write/append_growth use except BaseException as primary: close(rec, primary); raise, and a separate normal-path close. Same rule applied to the reader/schema/adapter case proxy finalizers (clear_orphans) through a _Cleanup context manager that passes the in-flight exception (same defect class: finalizer replacing a primary).

finding_map.finding: close_since catches every BaseException and returns the first; callers discard it or convert it to ERROR, so an uninjected KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit during cleanup without a primary need not propagate.
finding_map.planned_change: close_since(index, keep=None, primary=None) attempts every unattempted row once, latches all outcomes, returns the first error, and after all attempts raises the first newly arising non-Exception BaseException unless a non-Exception BaseException primary is active (_escalates rule). _open_dir/_bootstrap_read use explicit except BaseException as primary paths plus a separate success-path cleanup; per-case cleanup runs after the case try statement (no primary) inside its own BaseException handler that emits the emergency line and re-raises; the run-level finally becomes except BaseException as primary: close_since(0, primary=primary); raise. clear_orphans(primary=None) follows the same rule.

finding_map.finding: After the last loop deadline observation, protected-state reads, provisional summary write, final close and stdout emission can cross the original deadline and run() can still return 0.
finding_map.planned_change: _Fx.write/append_growth check the original deadline after the returned write/close. Finalization: deadline observed after protected-state reads (code 5), HarnessDeadlineExceeded from the provisional summary write latched, deadline re-observed after final harness close (code 5 overrides), and re-observed after the final stdout emission: a late return yields exit 5 (the process exit code is authoritative; the already-emitted summary line is then non-authoritative). On-disk summary stays PRE_FINAL_HARNESS_CLOSE_PROVISIONAL.
